name: x-post-image-1x1
description: Single-image X post, square at 1200x1200 (inside X's 2:1-3:4 range, shows uncropped; 1200x1200 is a working size, unverified). Takes more feed height than 16:9 on phones. Good for a quote line or a calm still. Brand-neutral placeholder; pair with alt text.

layers.text: One short line from the episode that stands on its own.
